prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need. That said, two Kansas City agencies widely regarded for quality work are:

- Barkley — large, independent full-service creative agency (brand strategy, creative, media). Known for strong creative campaigns and integrated work.  
- VML (VMLY&R) — global digital and experience agency with major presence in KC, strong on digital/product experience, CRM and large-brand work.

How to pick the best fit
- Define your objective: brand-building vs. performance (lead gen/sales), B2B vs. B2C, product launches, PR, etc.  
- Look for evidence: case studies with measurable results, clients in your industry, awards/references.  
- Team & culture: who will work on your account, their experience, and how they communicate.  
- Pricing & scope: clear scoping, KPIs, reporting cadence and exit terms.  
- Trial project: start with a small pilot to test fit before a long-term commitment.

If you tell me what you want to accomplish, your budget range, industry and timeline, I’ll suggest a short, tailored list of Kansas City agencies and specific questions to ask each.
